spf.comment: Anchored on the 3:0 and 2:0 home-win projections as Finland's possession and attacking availability decisively outmatch San Marino's 3.60 goals-conceded rate.

score.comment: 3:0 reflects Finland's 2.70 lambda against San Marino's 80% failed-to-score rate, with 2:0 hedging dead-rubber rotation and finishing waste.

goals.comment: 3 goals (22.3% Poisson) and 2 goals (20.9% Poisson) represent the two highest-density total-goal outcomes in the expected-goal matrix.

bqc.comment: San Marino trailed at half-time in 4 of 5 group games (Win-Win), while Finland's two home group matches were level at the break (Draw-Win).
